                               State of Rhode Island




JANUARY SESSION of the General Assembly begun and held at the State House in the City
of Providence on Tuesday, the Seventh day of January in the year of Our Lord Two
Thousand and Twenty-Five.

 Volume 152, No. 6            Tuesday, February 11, 2025                  Sixth Legislative Day


                                      CALL TO ORDER

The Senate meets pursuant to recess and is called to order by The Honorable Hanna M. Gallo,
Senate President Pro Tempore, at 4:13 o’clock P.M.

                                         ROLL CALL

The roll is called and a quorum is declared present with 37 Senators present and 1 Senator absent
as follows:

PRESENT –37: Senators Acosta, Appollonio, Bell, Bissaillon, Britto, Burke, Ciccone, de la
Cruz, DiMario, Dimitri, DiPalma, Euer, Felag, Gallo, Gu, Kallman, LaMountain, Lauria,
Lawson, Mack, McKenney, Morgan, Murray, Paolino, Patalano, Pearson, Quezada, Raptakis,
Rogers, Sosnowski, Thompson, Tikoian, Ujifusa, Urso, Valverde, Vargas and Zurier.

ABSENT – 1: The Honorable President Dominick Ruggerio.

                                        INVOCATION

The Honorable President Pro Tempore, by unanimous consent, presents Senator de la Cruz to
deliver the invocation.

                       PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE TO THE FLAG

The Honorable President Pro Tempore, by unanimous consent, presents Senator de la Cruz, to
lead the Senate in the pledge of allegiance to the flag.

                             IMMEDIATE CONSIDERATION

Senate Resolution No. 224
BY Ujifusa, Lawson, Tikoian, Mack, Acosta
ENTITLED, SENATE RESOLUTION PROCLAIMING FEBRUARY 11, 2025, AS "THE
2ND RHODE ISLAND REGIMENT/BLACK REGIMENT RECOGNITION DAY" TO
COMMEMORATE THE CONTRIBUTIONS OF BLACK SOLDIERS DURING THE
AMERICAN REVOLUTIONARY WAR
{LC150/1}

Recommended for Immediate Consideration.

Senator Ujifusa requests unanimous consent for immediate consideration.

Unanimous consent for immediate consideration is granted.

Senator Ujifusa moves passage, seconded by Senators Acosta, Appollonio, Bell, Bissaillon,
Britto, Burke, de la Cruz, DiMario, Dimitri, DiPalma, Euer, Felag, Gallo, Gu, Kallman,
LaMountain, Lauria, Lawson, Mack, McKenney, Morgan, Murray, Paolino, Patalano, Pearson,
Quezada, Raptakis, Rogers, Sosnowski, Thompson, Tikoian, Urso, Valverde, and Zurier.

The resolution is read and passed upon a voice vote.


                                           GUESTS

Tempore, welcomes to the Chamber Col. Joanne Breslin Commander of Varnum’s Regiment,
President of Varnum Continental Patrick Donovan Executive Director of the Varnum Armory
Museum East Greenwich, Jason Roomes First Rhode Island Regiment and descendent of Caesar
Rome Caretaker Curator a First Rhode Island Soldier, and John Harvey of the Varnum House.

                                       TRANSMITTAL
By unanimous consent, all matters on the Secretary’s desk are ordered to be transmitted to His
Excellency, the Governor, the Honorable Secretary of State or to the Honorable House of
Representatives forthwith.


                                     ANNOUNCEMENTS
Upon suggestion of Senator Mack and by unanimous consent, the Honorable President Pro
Tempore, welcomes to the Chamber Randall Ashe.
Senator Sosnowski announces that the Senate Committee on Commerce will meet today at the
rise of the senate in Room 212.
Senator Felag announces that the Senate Committee on Finance will meet today at the rise of the
senate in Room 211 and on Thursday, February 13th at 4:00pm in Room 211.
Senator Raptakis announces that the Senate Committee on Judiciary will meet today at the rise of
the senate in Room 313.
Senator Tikoian announces that the deadline to introduce new legislation will be extended until
Tuesday, February 25th.
                                           RECESS
Upon the Motion of Senate Majority Whip Tikoian, seconded by Senate Majority Leader
Lawson, the Senate stands in Recess at 4:41 o’clock P.M. in memory of Marie T. Nesselbush,
Rufina Delizo Rice, and Hilding T. Munson.

                            SENATOR JESSICA DE LA CRUZ
Dear Heavenly Father, We come before You today with gratitude for the opportunity to serve our
community and our nation. Grant us wisdom to lead with integrity, courage to make just
decisions, and humility to listen to those we represent. May our discussions be guided by
fairness, compassion, and a commitment to the common good. Bless this assembly with unity
and purpose, that our work may bring justice, prosperity, and peace to all. Amen.
